title: Why Is There a Little Arrow Next to Your Fuel Gauge?
description:
Look at the fuel gauge in your car. Next to the little fuel pump symbol, there is a tiny arrow. Most drivers have never noticed it, and it answers a question every driver has asked at a petrol station. Your car is full of small parts like that, hiding in plain sight. Today, ten of them, and why each one exists.

Machine Reverse takes apart the machines you see every day and explains, part by part, why each one exists. This video covers 10 parts.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:59 1. The fuel gauge arrow
2:10 2. The black dots
3:17 3. The tread wear bars
4:23 4. The tyre hairs
5:24 5. The small rear window
6:29 6. The third brake light
7:34 7. The shark fin
8:39 8. The rear window lines
9:40 9. The tilted low beam
10:45 10. The dashboard sensor
11:44 The verdict

Sources:
- Fuel gauge arrow and Jim Moylan's 1986 Ford memo: Wikipedia, "Fuel gauge" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_gauge
- Windscreen frit (ceramic band, UV protection of adhesive, dot gradient): Wikipedia, "Windshield" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windshield
- Tread wear indicators and 1.6 mm minimum tread depth (EU): Wikipedia, "Tread" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tread and "Aquaplaning" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aquaplaning
- Tyre vent spews: Wikipedia, "Tire manufacturing" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tire_manufacturing
- Third brake light (CHMSL), US requirement from 1986 models: Wikipedia, "Automotive lighting" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Automotive_lighting and NHTSA https://www.nhtsa.gov/
- Shark fin antennas: Wikipedia, "Shark fin antenna" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shark_fin_antenna
- Rear window defroster: Wikipedia, "Defogger" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Defogger
- Asymmetric low beam: Wikipedia, "Headlamp" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Headlamp
- Sun load and automatic headlight sensors: Wikipedia, "Automotive lighting" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Automotive_lighting

Photos from Wikimedia Commons. Full credits and licenses: https://github.com/viniciushoscher-ctrl/machine-reverse/blob/main/agendamento/creditos/video31.md
